8923-IND.finance: Developed countries must meet equitable mitigation/adaptation finance and technology-transfer duties; India urges $1 trillion financing early.
8923-IND.capacity: India remains willing to extend capacity-building assistance to affected countries' armed forces against terrorism.
8923-IND.future_authority: No endorsement of an unspecified future text or future vote is established. Preserve real ongoing commitments and known historical actions.

8923-GBR.multiplier: Climate is a threat multiplier for fragile/conflict-affected states, not the sole cause of terrorism.
8923-GBR.example: Sahel rainfall changes fuel farmer/herder conflict and can enable violent extremism.
8923-GBR.glasgow: Glasgow keeps 1.5 degrees hope alive, with net-zero/deforestation commitments.
8923-GBR.finance: Double adaptation financing and meet $100 billion goal by 2023 at latest.
8923-GBR.reporting: Support comprehensive UN reporting on climate-security links and CTED examining terrorism's conditions.
8923-GBR.council: All UN parts including Council have a role; UK explicitly supports the submitted draft.
8923-GBR.participation: Women and girls must participate meaningfully in an inclusive approach, not just receive protection.
8923-GBR.future_authority: No endorsement of an unspecified future text or future vote is established. Preserve real ongoing commitments and known historical actions.

guards.country: Only requested national delegation; no other speaker or population/government conflation.
guards.grounding: No invented event, national stance/commitment, numerical condition or source claim; correct clauses do not cancel incompatible additions.
guards.attribution: No appropriation of another country's distinctive statement as an explicit own-country position. Shared principles allowed.
guards.time_authority: Past/proposed/adopted/recorded stages and source date/capacity correct; unknown future vote does not erase real ongoing commitments. Hypothetical analyst recommendations remain labeled.
guards.public: Nonempty uncapped public statement, no visible reasoning loop or extra turn.
guards.length: At most 240 whitespace-separated words. Soft writing aims are not extra pass criteria.

ratings: met/unmet/uncertain; strict all material and guard units met, uncertain not pass. Read complete raw output against sources.
scope: All positions are supplied. This tests realization/role-binding and conditional application, not learned national values, forecasting or autonomous multi-agent benefit. New source-only scores do not replace prior WPS application grades; application cases retain original12 inventory with new role-specific planned inputs.
